title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・収まらねえ熱

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One pulls out all the stops at the spring Tenno Sho. While the audience is clearly stunned by her performance, she isn't as excited about her victory as usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's only just begun climbing to the peak of the centrals now. A tense air settles over her as she sets her sights on the Takarazuka Kinen next.
